title: Connect a Coolify through its agent
subtitle: Tugra reads the Coolify database on its server through the Tugra agent. No Coolify API token needed.

choice.title: How do you want to read Coolify?

error.agent_offline: The agent is offline. Try again when it is back.
error.no_coolify: No Coolify was found on this server.
error.no_docker: Docker is not available on this server.
error.db_stopped: Coolify's database is not running on this server.
error.not_read_only: Coolify could not be read in a safe, read-only way.
error.unreadable: Coolify's database could not be read completely.
error.agent_read_failed: Coolify could not be read through the agent.
error.forbidden: Only an owner or admin of the team can connect Coolify through the agent, and only an owner can move from it.
error.unknown_team: That Coolify team has no projects.
error.throttled: Too many reads in a short time. Try again in a minute.
error.capability: The agent on this server has not been given the database capability. Turn it on in the server's capabilities, then check again.

connect.serverHint: Pick the server that runs your Coolify. Its Tugra agent reads Coolify's own database, read-only.
connect.ownerNeeded: An owner of {team} has to run this move. It needs the owner's permission to read secret values, and the owner checks and installs on the servers. Ask an owner to run it, or choose a server of a team you own.
connect.noServers: None of your servers has a connected Tugra agent yet. Add the Coolify server to Tugra first.
connect.optIn: Tugra will read the Coolify database on this server through its agent. Nothing is changed or stopped, and no secret value is read yet.
connect.secretsFound: Secret values found, not read yet
connect.continueHint: Next: match Coolify's servers to your Tugra servers.
connect.detected: Coolify found on {name}. Press Read Coolify to continue.

team.label: Coolify team
team.hint: This Coolify has several teams with projects. Pick the team whose settings (notifications, shared variables, tags, members) are read. The projects of every team are listed either way.
team.pickFirst: Pick a Coolify team to continue.
team.reading: Reading {team} from Coolify. This takes a few seconds…
